values.description: NestJS API base URL. Default local dev server.
Google OAuth ID token for User 1. Paste before Auth → Google Sign-In.
App JWT for User 1. Auto-saved after Google Sign-In. Used as default Bearer token.
Supabase-compatible JWT for Realtime WebSocket (User 1). Auto-saved at sign-in. Not used for REST.
Username for User 1. Used in Complete Registration and profile/trip list URLs.
Search string for Users → Search Users (`q` param).
Google OAuth ID token for User 2 (second Google account). Required for two-user flows.
App JWT for User 2. Auto-saved after Google Sign-In (User 2).
Supabase Realtime JWT for User 2. Auto-saved at sign-in.
Username for User 2. Used in Complete Registration (User 2).
Trip UUID. Auto-saved after Create Trip, or copy from List Trips. Used by most trip-scoped endpoints.
Invitation UUID. Copy from Get My Invitations (User 2) after User 1 sends an invite.
Poll UUID. Copy `id` from Voting → List Polls.
Poll option UUID. Copy `options[n].id` from List Polls for aktivitas/lainnya polls.
Date candidate UUID for tanggal polls. Copy from trip date candidates / poll options.
Itinerary activity UUID. Copy from Activities → List Activities.
User UUID of a trip member. Copy from Get Trip Members for remove-member requests.
Chat message UUID (User 1). Auto-saved from List/Send Text Message. Used for reply and delete.
Chat message UUID sent by User 2. Auto-saved from Send Text Message (User 2). Used for Delete Own Message (User 2).
Media document UUID. Auto-saved from List/Register Document. Used for Set Trip Cover and Delete Document.
R2 object key from Presign (e.g. trips/{tripId}/{uuid}.jpg). Used in Register Document body.
Presigned R2 PUT URL from Presign Upload. Used by Upload File to R2 (PUT). Expires in 5 minutes.
Presigned R2 GET URL (1 hour expiry) from Register Document or List Documents response `url`. Used by Verify Presigned Download URL.
MIME type for presign + R2 PUT upload. Must match on both requests (image/jpeg, image/png, video/mp4).
Pagination cursor from `next_cursor` in list responses. For chat: RFC3339 timestamp (e.g. 2026-07-13T04:28:14.108Z). Leave empty for page 1; enable cursor query param for page 2+.
Wishlist item UUID. Copy from List Wishlists or auto-saved after Create/Convert-to-Trip.
